items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Yeah I worked with Sidney, I worked with Sidney Desbeam.

ctx.x: Well Punch was a pretty good man. He was a pretty good man, but I mean he wasn't like the rest of them fellas. I mean he plays nice. And he's style of playing. But I mean he didn't have that style like Rosetta Boyd, you know what I mean? Like Rene and those kind of things. Rene and Chris Kelly. Yeah. Now I used to take, when we'd be on advertising, after we started getting them trucks, you take like Rene. Now he'd take old Rene, now he'd get out there, sometime he gets on out there on the ground. Sometime he sat…
Yeah I worked with Sidney, I worked with Sidney Desbeam.
